worked_solution:
The formula for ${}_{n}{P}_{r}$ is given by

$$
{}_{n}{P}_{r}=\frac{n!}{(n-r)!}\,.
$$

Substituting $n=52$ and $r=2$ into the above, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{}_{52}{P}_{2} & =\frac{52!}{(52-2)!} \\  & =\frac{52!}{50!} \\  & =\frac{52\cdot 51\cdot \cancel{50!}}{\cancel{50!}} \\  & =52\cdot 51 \\  & =2\,652.\end{aligned}
$$
